title: Installing Google Analytics Tracking Code
text:
## Installing Google Analytics Tracking Code
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000108611
1. If you have not yet installed Google Analytics 4 on your Brilliant Directories website, follow the steps in this article to copy and paste a Google Analytics 4 ID into the General Settings of your website. If you need to set up GA4, please see: Google Instructions: How to Set Up GA4
2. If you are still using Google Analytics 3, which is a Google Analytics ID that begins with UA-XXX, tracking has been deprecated and no longer works. You'll want to migrate to Google Analytics 4. If you need to migrate from GA3 to GA4, please see: Google Instructions: Migrate GA3 to GA4
3. If you've already manually added Google Analytics 4 Code to your website's HEAD or via Google Tag Manager , then no further action is required and the steps in this article DO NOT need to be followed. -- Manually Embed Google Analytics 4 Code (advanced method) -- Google Tag Manager Method

## How to Copy Google Analytics 4 ID
Sign in to your Google Analytics account .
Click Admin in the side menu of the website property.
At the top of the page, search for "Measurement ID".
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12159694554/original/Kqa5FBTiG7F4NnBh0OHY3FevVSHycSJb3Q.png?1744235543 | alt: ]

## Adding the Google Analytics 4 ID
Go to Settings » General Settings and click on the tab named Integrations
Copy the code and paste it into the Google Analytics 4 field.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12127280769/original/-gw4OFb-FE-iDTSTZi3YeO9OdDO9RISC2w.png?1687397238 | alt: ]
e.g.: G-XXXXXXX
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12127281374/original/b5FFBvStWs39BzqnpwiT2kUYJBezmv9YlA.png?1687399568 | alt: ]
This field works only with Google Analytics 4.

## If You're Still Using Google Analytics 3 ID (UA-XXX)
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12127485242/original/niI1WT_O1ABewU3AH7WbfRTEP9cUQm2PFQ.png?1687814180 | alt: ]
When the new GA4 ID is entered and saved the website will no longer show the old ID and start using only the new field:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12127484900/original/kaDdP0kEQVS4iFx1VH55wAlQqVV1saHTgA.png?1687813714 | alt: ]
